Verified against the reference: prettier forces a fitting paragraph open because the source put a horizontal run before its trailing comment. srcgap is correct here -- it preserves the run flat, and its broken form is a hard break, so this exact layout would fall out if the group broke. What is missing is a predicate that can ask whether the current source gap is non-empty and force its own group; no member of the count/child-count/all/text/multiline family reads the gap. Not a package bug: no expression in the IR reaches it.
